title: English Practice Quiz 0086
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Please ___ the correct answer.
questions.explanation: Choose is the base verb used after please.

questions.question: The test was ___ than I expected.
I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Will plus the base verb can express a future prediction.

questions.question: How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.
